objects.name: Analytic 2207
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows application such as a Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) server or Distributed Control System (DCS) interface generating anomalously high-frequency write Application Programming Interface (API) calls to field devices, exceeding the configured scan rate baseline for that point. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: opc:applog
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Open Platform Communications Data Access (OPC DA) write queue depth or write throughput to a single point exceeds configured baseline by a significant margin
